```{r setup-Rmd, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, 
                      fig.align = "center",
                      # make sure to create folder
                      fig.path = "../figures/02_AssignASVs")
```

# Prepare Environment
```{r setup}
set.seed(238428)

# set the number of threads
n_threads = 8

# Load packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dada2, patchwork,
               install = FALSE)

```

# Load in QC'd FastQ files
```{r load-fastqs}
filtered_fatsqs_path <- "data/01_QualityTrimming/filtered_fastqs"

#Forward read vector
filtered_forward_reads <- list.files(filtered_fatsqs_path, pattern = "R1_filtered.fastq.gz",
           full.names = TRUE)

#Reverse read vector
filtered_reverse_reads <- list.files(filtered_fatsqs_path, pattern = "R2_filtered.fastq.gz",
           full.names = TRUE)

# Create vector of sample names
sample_names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(filtered_forward_reads), "_"), `[`,1) 
```


# Error Model 

## Learn errors

```{r learn-errors}
# Forward
error_forward_reads <-
  learnErrors(filtered_forward_reads, multithread = n_threads)

#Reverse
error_reverse_reads <-
  learnErrors(filtered_reverse_reads, multithread = n_threads)

#Plot the errors
## Forward
forward_error_plot <-
  plotErrors(error_forward_reads, nominalQ = TRUE) +
  labs(title= "Forward Reads: Error Model")

## Reverse
reverse_error_plot <-
  plotErrors(error_reverse_reads, nominalQ = TRUE) +
  labs(title= "Reverse Reads: Error Model")


# Plot them together
forward_error_plot + reverse_error_plot

```

# Infer ASVs seperately on Forward and Reverse Reads

```{r infer-ASVs}

#Forwards ASV inference
dada_forward <-
  dada(filtered_forward_reads,
       err = error_forward_reads,
       multithread = n_threads)

# Reverse ASV Inference
dada_reverse <-
  dada(filtered_reverse_reads,
       err = error_reverse_reads,
       multithread = n_threads)

# Take a look at the data
typeof(dada_forward)
dada_forward
str(dada_forward)
```

# Merge Forwards and Reverse Reads

```{r merge-ASVs}
merge_ASVs <-
  mergePairs(dada_forward, filtered_forward_reads,
             dada_reverse, filtered_reverse_reads,
             verbose = TRUE)
# Evaluate the output
typeof(merge_ASVs)
length(merge_ASVs)
head(merge_ASVs)

#take a look at the sample
merge_ASVs$WaterControl_R1_filtered.fastq_gz
```

# Create Raw ASV count table

```{r raw-asv-table}
raw_ASV_table <-
  makeSequenceTable(merge_ASVs)

# What are the dimensions of that table

dim(raw_ASV_table)
rownames(raw_ASV_table)
colnames(raw_ASV_table)
typeof(raw_ASV_table)
class(raw_ASV_table)

```
